Introduction¶

Welcome to the Streamlit SNCF app project documentation. This documentation was generated with AutoAPI, based on “Napoleon” and “Google”-style docstrings.

The main app purpose and installation/use guidelines are depicted in the following Purpose, Installation and Usage pages.

Also, the description of each item the project is made of are described (prupose, arugments, outputs). Each description is stored in each module’s page, following the project’s structure tree.

For more information about the project development details and usage, please follow the link: https://github.com/pmarlier/streamlit_sncf
